test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: I spend 25% of my salary on rent, 20% of my salary on transport, 40% of the remaining salary on groceries, and save the remaining part, which is ₹16,500. What is my salary?
solution:
**Given:**

Spend 25% of salary on rent.

Spend 20% of salary on transport.

40% of the remaining salary on groceries.

After all spending, he has ₹16,500.

**Calculation:**

According to question,

⇒ 100% - 25% - 20% = 55%

⇒ 60% × 55% = 33% 

33% of salary equals ₹16,500, Therefore

⇒ Salary = 16,500/0.33 = ₹50,000

**∴ Salary is ₹50,000.**
